assetGroup: Standalone whole influenza virion - single assembled mesh, not a deconstructible/piece set
componentMapping: biology > microbiology > Virus (low-level item) - re-sourced replacement candidate for the influenza gap flagged in docs/assets/biology-cell.md / docs/assets/reviews/biology-cell-visual.md, where the earlier 3-piece deconstructible set (virus-influenza-capsid-rna-nih.glb + envelope-a/b) had its capsid-RNA disc REJECTed and both envelope halves marked CONDITIONAL (neither reads as 'a virus' alone). This file is a single, whole, exterior-recognizable virion in one mesh - PRIMARY candidate for the Virus component's influenza-specific display.
underlyingStructureData: Derived from electron microscopy data provided by Bernard Heymann (NCI); segmented/colorized by Darrell Hurt (NIAID). Surface coloring: blue = hemagglutinin, red = neuraminidase, yellow = viral membrane.
creator: Darrell Hurt (NIAID, NIH)
attributionText: Not legally required. Recommended credit: "Influenza virus", NIH 3D (3d.nih.gov, entry 3DPX-000030), by Darrell Hurt (NIAID/NIH), from EM data provided by Bernard Heymann (NCI). CC0 1.0.
redistributionStatus: Unrestricted (CC0 public domain dedication) - confirmed via the entry page's own "Public Domain" badge linking to https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/.

validation.meshAttributes: POSITION + COLOR_0 (real per-vertex color: blue/red/yellow protein coloring, no NORMAL attribute present)
validation.notes: Comfortably within the 15MB hero-asset budget (2.9MB). No NORMAL accessor - would render flat/unlit through a loader that doesn't auto-compute vertex normals (same gap noted on several Wave-1 NIH files); needs computeVertexNormals() or an equivalent fix at integration time. Single continuous mesh (not a multi-piece assembly), spherical/spiky silhouette densely covered in protein knobs, closely resembles the general 'iconic virus' shape of the already-shipped polio capsid but with distinct two-tone (blue/red) surface coloring matching real hemagglutinin/neuraminidase distribution. STATUS: render-review-pending - not self-declared PASS; needs a visual-acceptance pass (per the pattern in docs/assets/reviews/biology-cell-visual.md) before any route/registry integration.
